sourceOfTruth: graduation production routes, Vue pages, APIs and services
productionImplementationStatus: all eight production workspaces registered with key routes, version boundaries, release gates and archive constraints
principles: batch context spans eligibility, mentor, topic, proposal, process, artifact, defense, grade and archive
identity facts remain in unified student and teacher masters
topic submission, review, publication, student selection, mentor confirmation and final allocation are separate
materials, guidance, milestones, results and scores preserve versions
proposal approval never implies artifact, defense or grade approval
originality evidence never automatically creates an academic conclusion
defense publication rechecks group, time, room, student, judge, recusal and conflict facts
score calculation, review, publication and dispute remain separate
missing materials block a complete archive package
downloads require permission, scope, purpose, watermark and audit
